In PVH's fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 (referred to as fiscal 2025), its gross margin fell to 57.5% from 59.4% in fiscal 2024 [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 21]. 

The decline was driven by:
1. Approximately 80 basis points from the gross negative impact of tariffs enacted in the first quarter of 2025 on goods entering the United States [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 21].
2. Approximately 50 basis points from transitioning previously licensed product categories into the directly operated wholesale business [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 22].
3. A remaining 60 basis point decrease driven by increased promotional selling, higher freight costs, and incremental customer discounts addressing Calvin Klein product delivery delays [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 22].

These negative impacts were partially offset by lower product costs, favorable foreign exchange transactional impacts in international businesses, and tariff mitigation actions [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 22].

For both PVH and Ralph Lauren, foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations impact financial results through translation and transaction effects [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 63 | fiscal year end 2026-02-01] [RL | Item 1A. Risk Factors | chunk 7 | fiscal year end 2026-03-28]. 

- **Translational impact:** The financial results of international subsidiaries with local functional currencies are translated into U.S. dollars for reporting [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 63 | fiscal year end 2026-02-01] [RL | Item 1A. Risk Factors | chunk 7 | fiscal year end 2026-03-28]. A strengthening U.S. dollar unfavorably impacts reported revenue and earnings, while a weakening U.S. dollar has a favorable impact [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 10 | fiscal year end 2026-02-01].
- **Transactional impact:** Foreign operations and subsidiaries are exposed when purchasing inventory or incurring costs in currencies other than their functional currency (such as foreign entities purchasing inventory in U.S. dollars) [PVH | Item 1A. Risk Factors | chunk 40 | fiscal year end 2026-02-01] [RL | Item 1A. Risk Factors | chunk 6 | fiscal year end 2026-03-28]. 
- **Risk Mitigation:** Both companies use derivative instruments—such as forward foreign currency exchange contracts and cross-currency swaps—to manage and mitigate cash flow and market risks related to these inventory and intercompany transactions, though these strategies do not entirely eliminate foreign exchange risks [PVH | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 65 | fiscal year end 2026-02-01] [RL | Item 7. MD&A | chunk 56 | fiscal year end 2026-03-28].
